description: The Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven's Stingerquill school and its dean.

timeline.summary: The five Founder Sphinxes, created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence, found Hexhaven to share magic with the plane's denizens.
timeline.quote: With the other four sphinxes, they helped found Hexhaven, sharing their knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "Aerid Konstrari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Founder Sphinxes and cadets fight Emrakul as she distinguishes one plane from another and pulls matter into her maw.
timeline.quote: "She is distinguishing one plane from the other!"

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 10: Happy Birthday" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An elder sphinx who composed the canons of the School of Painful Words.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

pages_say.description: A sphinx who reads emotions and influences others with words, teaching followers to draw power from their core; her group is Hexhaven's first line of defense against mage hunters and witchstalkers.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
